integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Begin from <Picture 1>. Live-action, cinematic, bright sunny morning, telephoto compression, only she sharp against a creamy green bokeh of maple foliage and a blurred apartment block, warm backlight rimming her hair and the red fringe of her scarf.

Aya is already running at full pace straight at the camera, centred in the frame, framed from the top of her head to mid-shin, and she is already late and already panicking. She is a schoolgirl with a short brown bob and a side-swept fringe, a thick red tartan scarf whose long fringed tail streams out to one side, a navy double-breasted coat with dark buttons, a navy pleated skirt flaring with her stride, black knee-high socks and black loafers. In her right hand she grips a dark backpack and a pink gingham bag together, hanging as one weight and swinging against the phase of her stride, never switching hands and never leaving the frame.

One continuous shot with no cuts. The camera performs a single backward tracking shot, retreating in front of her at exactly her running speed, smooth and level, so her size in the frame never grows and never shrinks and she never leaves the centre, while the leaning steel poles, the hedge and the near leaves stream past behind her. SPEED IS CRITICAL: everything moves at normal real-time speed, like 24fps footage played back at 24fps — natural motion, NO slow motion.

Her face runs through four states that replace one another and never repeat. She opens in pure alarm: brows up and apart, eyes wide, mouth open, chin pushed forward, jaw working between breaths and nostrils pulsing with each inhale. As she drives harder her brows knot down, her eyes narrow to a held squint and her teeth show in a hard exhale. When her forward foot catches and she lurches, catching herself inside a single stride without breaking rhythm or losing speed, her brows jump, her mouth drops open and her eyes squeeze fully shut before springing open wider than before. She finishes in hard resolve: brows locked down, eyes burning straight ahead, mouth wide open with her jaw working between breaths, the flush across her cheeks at its deepest. Her eyes are never still, carrying a fine searching tremor, one flick to the left, and several blinks of different quality — a tight squeeze, a full reflex shut at the stumble, a double flutter, and one slow held blink near the end.

Her stride shortens into choppy urgent steps, lengthens as she drives harder, breaks once at the stumble, then becomes the fastest cadence of the take. She never slows down, never stops and never looks back. The shot ends in mid-stride, still running at full pace, the backpack and the pink gingham bag still swinging together in her right hand, and her face held in the hard grimace of resolve.

overall_soundscape: Fast uneven hard footfalls on asphalt, faster at the end than at the beginning, her hard open-mouthed breathing, the rustle of coat and skirt fabric, the clink and sway of the two bags, one sharp exhale, one startled gasp, one swallow, and bright morning birdsong in the trees. No voice is heard.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse plucked motif at a quick tempo over a sustained low string bed, the plucks tightening as her pace rises and holding under the final frame.

**音频去噪必须设为 1 / Audio denoise must be set to 1**

- 设为 0 会锁住第一阶段的粗糙音频，声音不拟合
  Setting it to 0 locks in the rough Stage 1 audio, and the sound will not fit the video.
- 放大模型固定 2 倍，所以第一阶段分辨率要是目标的一半
  The upscaler is fixed at 2x, so the Stage 1 resolution must be half of the target.
- 第二阶段采样器用「禁用噪波」（DisableNoise），加噪已由放大节点完成
  Stage 2 uses DisableNoise, because the upscale node has already added the noise.

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
